drawings.description: dessin : un triangle aux trois sommets marqués d'un point, coupé par un arc joignant les deux sommets de la base, avec une petite croix au milieu de la base
drawings.notes: Triangle with its three vertices marked by dots, cut by an arc joining the two base vertices, and a small cross in the middle of the base. The two small drawings above it on the page (with "ou") are covered by a note of the transcription, not by this mark.

drawings.description: schéma de sa main en haut de la page, sans texte qui l'introduise ; les traits se terminent par un petit crochet, rendu par des flèches à crochet dans le sens où ils sont tracés. Il se rapporte à la Proposition de la page 16, où $L = F.G$
drawings.notes: Omb F and Omb G above, Omb(F) cap Omb(G) in the middle, Omb(L) below; three strokes, each ending in his small hook, drawn as on the page.

drawings.description: schéma d'inclusions tracé par simples traits ; un premier « $\mathrm{omb}(Y)$ » est biffé et récrit à côté
drawings.notes: omb(X) and omb(Y) above, omb(X) cap omb(Y), omb(L) below, joined by plain strokes. The first omb(Y) is drawn grey as struck, after the transcription (the strike is hardly visible at this resolution). The formulas in the upper part of the crop are not part of the drawing and are left out.

drawings.description: sous cette ligne biffée, un croquis : une droite portant, de gauche à droite, un segment subdivisé en deux, un point isolé, un segment, deux points, un segment plus long subdivisé, un segment finement subdivisé, un point — une figure finie de l'exemple
drawings.notes: Encoded as segment-config/1 (points a..r left to right; "bracket" = an end or subdivision tick, "isolated" = a 0-stratum alone), re-read on a wider crop. Left to right: a segment subdivided in three (a-b-c-d: the mark near its right end, not encoded before, is a clear cross tick like the others), an isolated point e, a segment f-g, two points h, i, a longer segment subdivided in two (j-k-l), a finely subdivided segment (m..q, four pieces: five ticks), a point r. The line itself is not drawn by him: the pieces are separate. Disagreement: the transcription says the first segment is subdivided in two; on the crop it has two interior ticks, so three pieces. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.disagreement: The transcription's « un segment subdivisé en deux » (the first one): on the crop it carries two interior ticks, i.e. three pieces.

drawings.description: dessin : un fuseau fermé, deux arcs joignant un point marqué $0$ à gauche à un point marqué $1$ à droite ; une croix $x$ sur l'arc supérieur ; à côté, « (\uncertain{saisons} \ill{}) » ; sous le dessin, « (un \ill{} $x$ de $]0,1[$) »
drawings.notes: Redrawn on a tight crop. Closed spindle: two arcs from the point 0 (left) to the point 1 (right), both ending on the same two computed points; the cross on the upper arc (it carries no separate letter x above it: the x of the transcription is the cross itself; the raised x at the right of the lower arc belongs to the legend). The legend under the drawing is written as the transcription reads it. Left out: the legend on the right ("(saisons ...)", partly illegible), the long thin curve from the lower left rising to the right edge under the legend (the oblique marginal note's link), the text lines. Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: dessin à gauche : un fuseau de $0$ à $1$ ; sur l'arc supérieur les points $x_1$, $(x_3)$, $x_2$, sur l'arc inférieur $x'_2$, $(x'_3)$, $x'_1$ ; les segments $[x_1, x_2]$ et $[x'_2, x'_1]$ sont repassés en gras ; à côté, « $z_1 = (x_1, x'_1)$ », « $z_2 = (x_2, x'_2)$ »
drawings.notes: Spindle from 0 to 1; on the upper arc x_1, (x_3), x_2, on the lower arc x'_2, (x'_3), x'_1; the segments [x_1, x_2] and [x'_2, x'_1] thick; on the left z_1 = (x_1, x'_1), z_2 = (x_2, x'_2). The formula under the drawing belongs to the text.

drawings.description: dessin : une chaîne de quatre sommets reliés $A'$ — $A$ — $B$ — $B'$, des pointillés prolongeant le graphe au-delà de $A'$ et de $B'$
drawings.notes: Chain of four vertices A' - A - B - B'. The dotted continuations are drawn where they stand on the page: two short dashed strokes to the left of A' (one level with the chain, one lower) and a short dash at the right edge, beyond B'. Not encoded: the figure is explicitly a part of a larger graph.

drawings.description: schéma en losange à gauche de la démonstration ; à gauche, « $X'' \in$ » pointe vers $\widetilde{X}'$, à droite « $\ni Y''$ » vers $\widetilde{Y}'$
drawings.notes: Lozenge: X~ and Y~ at the top; X~', L, Y~'; X'_L, Y'_L; L' at the bottom, joined by plain strokes; on the left "X'' in" pointing to X~', on the right "ni Y''" towards Y~' (cut at the crop edge). Strokes placed between the labels; their exact ends are approximate.
